newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSO says in senior talks with BHP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSO says in senior talks with BHP.

text.p: The Central Selling Organization (CSO), controlled by South Africa's De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd is holding senior level talks with Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd about marketing BHP's Lac de Gras mine in Canada, the executive director of De Beers, and the CSO, Tim Capon, said on Sunday.

"I think the courting, if you can call it that, is at the point where there has been contact at a very senior level between our people and senior people at BHP," Capon said on Channel Nine TV's Business Sunday programme.
He said a CSO contract was "one of the alternatives" BHP was studying. In November, De Beers said the talks were at a preliminary stage.
BHP has previously said it is undecided on how it will market output from the diamond mine, forecast to yield 4.5 million carats a year for 25 years starting in the second half of 1998.

Argyle Diamond Mines Pty Ltd of Australia, wholly-owned by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd earlier this year dropped out of the CSO, marking the first time since the 1970s that a diamond company sought independence from the London-based organisation. The CSO is estimated to market about half the world's diamonds. -- James Regan Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
